description: This Java class 'DittoBsonJson' is a utility for converting between BSON and JSON formats, specifically tailored for handling MongoDB data in the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages special character escaping for JSON keys when serializing and parsing, ensuring compatibility with MongoDB constraints regarding key characters like '.' and '$'.
